artworks.title: Head of Medusa
artworks.description: This engraving shows an ornamental design with symmetrical features. At the top, two winged humanoid figures face each other, holding up a decorative canopy resembling a tent. Between them, under the tent, a vase containing three large flowers sits on a thin tiered surface. Below this surface is a smiling human head with snakes on top of it and wings emerging from either side. Twisting lines appear from the bottom of the face, and it is surrounded by swirling lines. At the bottom, the heads of two animals face one another; they appear to be dogs with large plumes of feathers emerging from their heads. These heads are surrounded by more curving lines and some small circles. The designs of this engraving appear in white, while the background of the ornament is black. Outside of the ornament, the background is blank, tan paper.

artworks.title: Arabesque Designs
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate design with intricate patterns and two birds. The image features a symmetrical design with swirling floral elements, decorative flourishes, and two birds facing each other. The drawing is dominated by a central intricate motif with scrolling foliage. At the top of the composition is a small decorative element resembling a stylized canopy or umbrella. The design is surrounded by a complex border.

artworks.title: Mars
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate emblem featuring a detailed central figure. The design shows a classical warrior figure surrounded by decorative elements including scrollwork, mythical creatures, and floral motifs. The emblem has a symmetrical framework. At the top, a small face appears. The artwork exhibits characteristics of Renaissance ornamental engravings with delicate lines and detailed patterns.

artworks.title: Neptune
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative heraldic shield. The image features an ornate design centered around a standing figure holding a trident. The central figure is surrounded by an elaborate frame with symmetrical ornate elements resembling curled foliage, volutes, and scrolls. Stylized fish are on either side of the figure, while below, two sea creature-like forms are symmetrically positioned. The drawing is intricately detailed, utilizing ornamental motifs in a monochromatic color scheme with a strong emphasis on contrast and symmetry.

artworks.title: Orlando in a Fury Tearing up Trees
artworks.description: This print shows a bearded man holding the trunk of a long tree over one shoulder. He is in a wide stance, legs bent and his body turned to lift the trunk. He is mostly naked with a small cloth hanging over one of his thighs and draping over his groin. He has pale skin with a muscular build, and he looks over his shoulder up to the right, his eyes wide and his mouth partially open. Armor pieces, including a helmet and shield or breastplate, are on the ground behind him, along with a long lance. A horse stands on the right behind the discarded armor, facing away from us, rearing up and turning its head back to look at the man. Slightly above center, two people are peek out from behind foliage, looking at the man. One of the people raises their arm over their head. The setting is a dense forest with large trees obscuring all most all of the gray sky, and the ground beneath the man is littered with small rocks and leaves.

artworks.title: Cherub
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an ornate, symmetrical design featuring a cherubic face and floral motifs. The central figure of the design is a cherubic face adorned with wings emanating from the haloed head, appearing at the top center of the outlined, shield-like form. Around this face are elaborate floral motifs, including flowers, vines, and tendrils that create a balanced and decorative pattern. Two stylized scrolls or horns of plenty extend across the sides, overflowing with foliage. Towards the bottom section of the design, there's a central floral figure surrounded by more curling lines. The use of dark ink on a light background emphasizes the complexity and richness of the design.

artworks.title: Female Figure
artworks.description: This is a print of a symmetrical ornament decorated with several figures. In the lower center is the largest figure, who appears to be a human with wings. Their torso is bare, and they have no legs, but instead two swirling lines below their navel. This figure is surrounded by motifs like winged animals, scrolls, leaves, feathers, floral elements, and decorative swirls. Winged horses, the heads of lions, a bird, and a fish are distinguishable. The design is black, and the details are the tan color of the paper the print is on.

artworks.title: Griff
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of the head and upper torso of a person in profile. The person is leaning forward slightly with their head tilted downwards to the lower right corner. Their facial features include a prominent nose, downward-facing eyes, a bushy beard, and a receding hairline. They wear a garment with a high collar. The background is blank, emphasizing the pencil sketch of the individual.

artworks.title: Ernest Casimir, Count of Nassau-Dietz
artworks.artist: Willem Jacobsz Delff after Michiel van Miereveld
artworks.description: In this image, there is an illustrated portrait of a man in formal attire. He is shown in an official pose, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a full mustache and a small goatee, with wavy hair styled back. He wears an elaborate doublet with a high, lace collar and a breastplate underneath. The background is dark, and the portrait is framed by an oval border. Text below the image likely identifies the person depicted.

artworks.title: Les attitudes sont faciles et chastes
artworks.artist: Maurice Denis, Ambroise Vollard (publisher), Auguste Clot (technician)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on thin yellowish/cream wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows the upper body of a person seated, with closed eyes and light brown hair. They are wearing a blue garment with a floral pattern and a pink rose near the neckline. The person's hand touches the rose. In the background, there are green trees, a grassy area, a figure in blue walking a white dog on a pathway, and tree branches partially obscuring a patch of blue sky.

artworks.title: Le bouquet matinal, les larmes
artworks.artist: Maurice Denis, Ambroise Vollard (publisher),  Auguste Clot (technician)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on thin yellowish/cream wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person's upper body, from the shoulders up, with one arm extended outward. The person is facing backward but their head is turned to the side, showing light-colored hair styled away from the face. The person wears a garment with short sleeves. They hold an object decorated with pink flowers and green leaves, possibly a floral arrangement. In the background, there is a garden scene with trees, foliage, and a circular pond or fountain.

artworks.title: Les crépuscules ont une douceur d'ancienne peinture
artworks.artist: Maurice Denis, Ambroise Vollard (publisher), Auguste Clot (technician)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on thin yellowish/cream wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the knees up, slightly angled towards the viewer with their upper body turned to the left. They have long golden hair flowing over their shoulder and down their back. The individual has a delicate expression with soft features, wearing a long light pink dress with a subtle pattern. Their left hand rests against their waist. In the surroundings, there is a bush with triangular pink flowers and a light yellow sky in the background. Faint outlines of greenery, dark trees, and buildings can be seen on the horizon. The person is not wearing any visible jewelry or holding any objects.

artworks.title: Le chevalier n'est pas mort à la croisade
artworks.artist: Maurice Denis, Ambroise Vollard (publisher), Auguste Clot (technician)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on thin yellowish/cream wove paper
artworks.description: The image features soft, rounded shapes and gentle lines. In this abstract scene, a figure with delicate facial features and wavy hair is depicted in profile, hands raised near the face. To the left, a checkerboard pattern of alternating black and white squares suggests the floor of an interior space, leading the eye to an archway beyond. Through the arch, the faint outline of a horse stands amidst a foggy background, its form subtly merging with abstract shapes that resemble distant trees or clouds.

artworks.title: La facade de l'abbaye de S. Nicaise de Reims
artworks.description: The image depicts a grand Gothic cathedral with intricate architectural details, including two tall spires. The sky above shows softly rendered clouds. The cathedral's rooftops and spires form a boundary with the sky. The detailed brushstrokes capture the ornate decorations and stonework. The color palette is monochromatic, focusing on shades of sepia and black. In front of the cathedral, figures engage in various activities. Modest structures and trees are visible in the distance.

artworks.title: Samuel Johnson
artworks.artist: William Doughty after Sir Joshua Reynolds
artworks.description: The image depicts a portrait of a man seated with his upper body visible. He has a round face with pronounced eyebrows, deep-set eyes, and full lips. His hair is styled in thick curls reminiscent of an 18th-century wig. The man is wearing a double-breasted coat with large buttons and a white shirt visible at the collar and cuffs. He is facing slightly to the right, with his left arm either resting on a surface or in his lap. The background is plain, possibly a dark-colored wall.

artworks.title: Jacques-Benigne Bossuet
artworks.description: This print shows a man standing upright, his head slightly turned to the left. He has pale skin, a full head of wavy white hair, and a thin white mustache, and he seems to be smiling slightly. He wears ornate clerical robes with intricate lace at the bottom, and a large cross pendant hangs from his neck. He holds a dark, square-cornered hat in his left hand, while his right hand rests on a book that is placed on a richly decorated table. The background features grand architectural columns and heavy drapery, with stacks of books and papers at his feet by the bottom left corner. There is a rectangular border surrounding the print, and several lines of text at the bottom

artworks.title: Louis-Alexandre de Bourdon, comte de Toulouse
artworks.description: The image displays a bust portrait of a person within an oval frame. The individual is facing slightly to the right, with their head turned towards the viewer. They have long, curly hair and are wearing a suit of armor, including a breastplate and decorative shoulder guards. The person has distinct facial features and is looking forward. Their right arm is raised with the hand pointing to the right side. The background has a patterned texture, and the frame includes an inscription and decorative elements. A coat of arms is shown at the bottom center of the frame.

artworks.title: Marie de Laubespine
artworks.artist: Pierre Drevet after Nicolas de Largillierre
artworks.description: The image is a portrait of a woman showing her upper body and part of her lower body in a seated position. Her head is turned slightly towards the viewer, and she has a calm expression on her face. She has curly hair styled in an elaborate fashion. She is wearing a luxurious dress with puffed sleeves, lace, and embroidery, possibly accented with fur around her shoulder, and is seated on a draped fabric. In her lap, she is holding a small dog. The background features large draped curtains and ornate architectural elements, including columns and possibly a carved or painted wall.

artworks.title: André Hercules, Cardinal de Fleury
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man seated in an elaborately carved chair. His upper body and part of his lower body are visible. He is facing slightly to the left, looking directly at the viewer. The man has a prominent nose, deep-set eyes, and thin lips. His gray, wavy hair falls to his shoulders. He is wearing ecclesiastical attire with fur trim. His hands are resting on a bundled cloth in his lap, and he appears to be holding a document or book. The setting includes a table with books and an inkstand with quills. Heavy drapery with an ornate pattern and tassels hangs in the background.

artworks.title: Riding School
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rider on horseback in a rural setting. The image depicts a rider on a prancing horse, holding a long thin instrument. In the foreground, a man stands beside a post, also with a narrow object in hand. In the background, two figures walk along a path near ruins or an old structure. The scene evokes a rustic ambiance with a sense of motion. The detailing and use of light and shadow suggest a historical or classical setting, highlighting the relationship between humans and animals in a cultivated landscape.

artworks.title: River Landscape with Horseman
artworks.description: The image displays a rider on horseback on the right side. The rider wears a wide-brimmed hat and holds a staff, looking towards the left where a cliff is visible. The cliff has detailed linework and a small structure on top, possibly a tower or castle. The horizon is high in the image, emphasizing the vast landscape and the cliff. The brushstrokes are intricate, with fine lines and cross-hatching creating texture in the cliff and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and white. In the distance, a small village with slender spires is visible.

artworks.title: View in England (Vue prise en Angleterre)
artworks.description: The image shows a view from an elevated angle overlooking water with two anchored boats. The horizon, trees, boats, a horse on a rocky outcrop, and dramatic clouds in the sky are portrayed in a monochrome palette using shades of black, white, and gray. The painting style features soft, blended lines creating a moody atmosphere.

artworks.title: Three Pigs
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene with a simple, thatched-roofed barn. Two pigs are in the foreground, while another pig is inside the barn. There are shrubs, trees, and a cloudy sky in the background. The color palette is monochromatic, with dark strokes contrasting with the light background.

artworks.title: The Ravisher
artworks.description: This is a drawing of figures in a natural setting. The illustration portrays a woman in medieval-style attire sitting next to a wild-looking figure. The background features swirling lines and branches, creating a textured backdrop. An ornate scroll is present across the top. The detailed line work and hatching add volume and intricate detailing, typical of the period's graphic work. The composition's fluidity and theatricality suggest influence from Renaissance graphic traditions.
